description: Frame taken from the screen recording attached to the issue, at the point where a selection covers both the inline chip and the adjacent text and the bold control has been used. The chip renders in normal weight while the text beside it inside the same selection renders bold. Cropped to the editor surface: the product wordmark, the version banner and the debug state panel were outside the crop.

Frame from the same recording showing the surrounding document, where a paragraph of ordinary text on its own carries the bold format correctly, alongside the paragraph holding the chip. Cropped the same way.
